name: Payment Initiation Requested
description: Request emitted from a payment source document when a payment initiation is requested.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied key identifying one logical initiation attempt.

recipient.description: Prepared recipient reference. At minimum it must carry the opaque token.

documentId.description: Blue document id identifying the business document this payment is for.

paynote.description:
Optional PayNote bootstrap input.
If omitted, MyOS creates the default PayNote during initiation.

document.description: The PayNote document content to bootstrap.

channelBindings.description: Optional channel bindings keyed by the channel names declared in the PayNote document.
